name: app-black-founder-quote-with-tilted-climate-phone
title: Founder Quote with Tilted Climate Phone
whatItIs: A black slide with a large quote in alternating white and grey words, a lime quote mark, a founder avatar and title, and a steeply tilted cream climate control phone fading into black at the base.
whatItMeans: The fading phone and tone-shifting quote create depth, and the lime quote mark is the single accent.
techniques: Words alternating bright and grey in a quote
Lime quotation mark as an accent
Phone rotated steeply and faded at the bottom

vocabulary.definition: A device whose bottom dissolves into the background.
A quotation with words at alternating brightness.
A quotation mark in the brand accent colour.
